rationale: All five jobs independently run `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, which is repeated dependency fetching across every run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (evidence: pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, literature S01, reported benefit) supports caching dependency downloads keyed on the lockfile and environment. I added a `Restore dependency cache` step (actions/cache@v5, the same cache action already used in the build job) before `Install dependencies` in each job, keyed on `BUN_CACHE_SALT` plus hashes of `frontend/yarn.lock` and `frontend/package.json`, with a prefix restore-key. This preserves every check, test, timeout, permission, and artifact; it only shortens installs on warm caches. The cache key changes when the lockfile changes, so stale dependency trees are not reused, and no new network access, secrets, privileged actions, or publishing/deployment steps are introduced.
